svg.title: Top most utilised aircraft models — GET /api/aircraft-models/top-utilized?limit=5 (US204, contract B4b)

g.text: Top most utilised aircraft models — GET /api/aircraft-models/top-utilized?limit=5 (US204, contract B4b)
sum minutes per model (via the fleet)
sort by minutes desc (ties: model name)
Flight Routes only knows registrations, so the mapping registration → model is done here.
B4b (minutes-by-aircraft) accepts ATCC and BACKOFFICE_OPERATOR (contract Q4),
so US204 works for both roles. Other roles: 403 "Flight Routes rejected the request."
